itens.titulo: What Marvell's rosy long-term guidance means for our AI chip stocks
itens.descricao: What Marvell's rosy long-term guidance means for our AI chip stocks CNBC
trechos: Stocks are higher on Tuesday, with the S & P 500 and Nasdaq on pace for record closes.
For the S & P 500, it's fourth straight session of gains.
The rally came as Treasury yields slid slightly, while WTI crude remained under $90 per barrel.
Every sector in the S & P 500 was positive except for healthcare, which trailed due to weakness in Moderna and companies exposed to biotechs.
Marvell Technology shares rose over 6% on Tuesday in reaction to upbeat near-term and long-term guidance at its investor day.
Nvidia is up about 0.5%, tracking for back-to-back record closes, while Broadcom is jumping more than 4%, which would be its best day since late August.
Marvell raised its revenue outlook for fiscal 2028 to $20 billion, up from the $18 billion guidance it gave alongside side its fiscal 2027 second-quarter results in late August.
Marvell said the additional $2 billion of revenue is being driven by strong demand for its data center connectivity solutions: interconnect scale-up optics and switching.

itens.titulo: TSMC Q3 Earnings: Strong AI Demand Sets the Bar High for Growth
itens.descricao: TSMC Q3 Earnings: Strong AI Demand Sets the Bar High for Growth Yahoo Finance
trechos: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company TSM or TSMC will release its third-quarter 2026 earnings report this month with a strong revenue trajectory.
TSMC reported July revenues of NT$467.58 billion, up 44.7% year over year and 5.6% sequentially.
August revenues increased another 10.1% sequentially to NT$514.81 billion and rose 53.3% year over year.
The two months generated a combined NT$982.39 billion.
Q3 Revenue Projection Near Upper End of Guidance TSMC's third-quarter guidance calls for revenues of $44.6-$45.8 billion, based on an assumed exchange rate of NT$32 per U.S.
This translates into approximately NT$1.427-$1.466 trillion of quarterly revenues.

Given the NT$982.39 billion reported in July and August, September revenues of approximately NT$444.8-$483.2 billion would be sufficient to place third-quarter revenues within management's guided range.
The Zacks Consensus Estimate is slightly below the upper end of TSMC's revenue guidance at $45.62 billion, implying 37.8% year-over-year growth.

itens.titulo: Bolsa aos 200 mil, dólar abaixo de R$ 5 e DI em queda: onde colocar R$ 10 mil agora?
itens.descricao: Bolsa aos 200 mil, dólar abaixo de R$ 5 e DI em queda: onde colocar R$ 10 mil agora? Exame
trechos: As opiniões divergem quando a pergunta é onde colocar a maior parte dos R$ 10 mil.
A forte valorização do Ibovespa reduziu o espaço para ganhos rápidos no curtíssimo prazo, mas não significa que a bolsa brasileira (B3) tenha deixado de oferecer oportunidades.
"Depois da alta, realmente o espaço para uma alta forte agora no curto prazo é menor", afirma.
Nesta terça-feira, 6, por exemplo, o Ibovespa recua 0,64% por volta das 12h15 (horário de Brasília).
"Se você alocar em um desses mercados só nesse momento, eu preferia a renda fixa", afirma.
Fábio Murad, consultor da Wiser Asset, lembra que a Selic permanece em 13,75% ao ano e que os títulos continuam oferecendo taxas relevantes.
Patrimônio precisa estar preparado para vários cenários", afirma o consultor.

itens.titulo: JPMorgan rebaixa Banco do Brasil (BBAS3) para venda e ação cai mais de 5%
itens.descricao: JPMorgan rebaixa Banco do Brasil (BBAS3) para venda e ação cai mais de 5% Suno - Investimentos Inteligentes
trechos: As ações do Banco do Brasil (BBAS3) registram forte queda nesta terça-feira, após o JPMorgan revisar as recomendações para o setor financeiro brasileiro.
Por volta das 13h25, as ações do Banco do Brasil recuavam 6,42%, cotados a R$ 24,64.
Nesse horário, os papéis lideravam as perdas do Ibovespa, seguidos por BTG Pactual (BPAC11) e B3 (B3SA3).
Na mesma análise, o JPMorgan elevou a recomendação para as ações do Bradesco (BBDC4), que passaram de neutro para overweight, patamar equivalente à compra.
Por que o JPMorgan rebaixou o Banco do Brasil (BBAS3) Segundo o JPMorgan, a mudança nas recomendações do setor está relacionada a uma revisão no custo de capital.

O banco reduziu em cerca de 1,5 ponto percentual a premissa de custo de capital próprio aplicada à maior parte das empresas sob sua cobertura, acompanhando a queda da curva de juros brasileira de dez anos, que recuou de aproximadamente 14,4% para 13%.
Essa mudança, segundo a instituição, explica entre 15% e 20% dos aumentos de preços-alvo divulgados no relatório.
No caso específico do Banco do Brasil, o JPMorgan avalia que 2027 ainda deve ser um período desafiador, com recuperação projetada apenas para 2028.

itens.titulo: Marvell Technology stock rallies following ambitious investor day targets
itens.descricao: Marvell Technology stock rallies following ambitious investor day targets Yahoo Finance
trechos: While the stock briefly dipped 3% at the start of the meeting, shares sharply reversed course to jump as much as 10% on the outlook.
Shares were last up 7.5% in recent trading.

During the presentation, CEO Matt Murphy outlined a massive expansion in the company's market opportunity, telling investors that Marvell anticipates a $400 billion total addressable market (TAM) by 2030.
Marvell projects approximately $20 billion in total revenue for fiscal year 2028, with targets escalating to between $70 billion and $90 billion by fiscal year 2031.
The new $20 billion FY28 target represents a significant leap over consensus estimates.
Heading into the event, analysts were forecasting revenue of $12.05 billion for the current fiscal year (2027) and $18.2 billion for fiscal year 2028.

Achieving management's $20 billion goal would require substantial acceleration beyond the Street's view, continuing an aggressive growth trajectory that stems from a fiscal year 2026 baseline of $8.2 billion.
